During the Dog Training and Cynology course, we met several trainers from the Future of Dogs dog school, who taught us both theoretically and practically.
I can only say positive things about them, both professionally and personally. I am glad that I chose this school!
Good team, too bad I didn't find them sooner. Good advice, if you follow it you and your dog will improve quickly :) They are kind, professional, patient :)

Since Kinga, Noémi and Krisztián took over the dog school, there have been huge positive changes:
A dog- and owner-friendly attitude, fair, no-frills pricing, a guarantee and well-groomed, green grass await owners and their dogs.
A true dog paradise in the heart of the city!
I can only recommend it!

We had already tried several schools before we met Kinga and choosing her was the best decision. Whether it's individual or group lessons, both the dogs and the owners receive the right attention and support. We really like going here because they don't see it as a problem that they are Dalmatians and even deaf. On the contrary: we are on the verge of the BH exam and are already planning to continue. This way we can participate in the classes with freedom. And what we learned here also helps us a lot in everyday life to better understand our dog's signals.

We are grateful for your trust and support! 💛 We work every day to be even better - we believe in development and a positive attitude.
We also give you +1 free hour as a gift so that you can get even more out of working together!
The future of dogs depends on the dogs of the future! 🐾

We have been going to Kinga with my 7-month-old puppy for 3 months now.
Not only is my dog ​​developing spectacularly, but I also learn a lot every time. Kinga is incredibly patient, kind and, if necessary, firmly but always in a positive tone, helps and shows new techniques. I now understand my dog's signals much better and how to react in different situations. I am very happy that we found this school and Kinga😊

My (formerly very) anti-social dachshund and I go to dog school here every weekend. They pay a lot of attention to the dogs, we get good advice and the school is usually in a good mood, and my dachshund is also more courageous in the company of other dogs.
We really love going here with Fügi!!!! Great trainers, a nice big well-maintained track and a fantastic community :) I can only speak about them in superlatives ;) I highly recommend them!!!!
